names.note: Read out of the list of the thirteen Syrian fathers in doxologia.ro's life of John of Zedazeni, linked from its calendar line for 7 mai, «Sfântul Cuvios Ioan Zedazneli, dimpreună cu 12 ucenici din Georgia».
Read out of saint.gr's page for 7 Μαΐου, which heads him «Οσιος Ισε Μαθητης Του Οσιου Ιωαννη», with the rank words and the clause about his teacher left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог's naming clause in the entry headed „Преподобни оци грузијски.“ for 7. мај ст. ст. — „А имена су њихова: Авид, Антоније, Давид, Зинон, Тадеј, Иса, Издериос, Јосиф, Михаил, Пир, Стефан и Шијо.“ The list carries no rank word and no epithet on any of the twelve; Преподобни heads the whole company in the heading and belongs to no one name, and the see or monastery each folder's English name keeps is nowhere on this page. So the bare forename is the whole of the form. The form meets no other folder in any language, which was measured rather than assumed; it is three letters long and the gate's noise on a short skeleton is to be expected rather than read as a fold.

Read out of the `name:` link behind days.pravoslavie.ru’s line for 2 декабря ст. ст., name page 1113, «Святитель Исе (Иессей) Цилканский, епископ», with the rank word «Святитель» and the trailing grade «, епископ» left off. The bracket holds the fuller Biblical form of the same forename, which the life page uses interchangeably with the short one, and it is kept as the page prints it. The existing `sr` form on this folder is the bare «Иса» from a naming clause that listed thirteen men without epithets; this fuller form is what BRIEF-RUSSIAN section 2 asks for where the calendar gives it.

feast.note: His life page lists two days, «7 мая, 2 декабря», and the day page that names him is the 2 декабря one, so that is the day recorded here. The 7 мая is the common commemoration of the thirteen Syrian fathers, which the Greek and Romanian rows on this folder already keep; one row per church is the schema, so it is recorded here and he does not render on it. The life says besides that the exact day of his repose is known and is 18 августа, and that the Church set his memory on 2 декабря.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 2 декабря ст. ст. — «Прп. Исе (Иессея), еп. Цилканского (VI) (Груз.)»
Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 7 mai — «Sfântul Cuvios Ioan Zedazneli, dimpreună cu 12 ucenici din Georgia»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 7ης Μαΐου — «Όσιος Ιωάννης και οι μαθητές αυτού»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 7 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day the Romanian calendar keeps the company, and it is plainly the same company: John out of Syria and the twelve chosen to go into Iberia, whose names the page prints as «Σίω, Δαβίδ, Αντώνιος, Θαδδαίος, Στέφανος, Ισήδωρος, Μιχαήλ, Πύρρος, Ζήνων, Ισέ, Ιωσήφ και Άβιβος». **Thirteen head lines, thirteen names, so thirteen folders**, and the corpus already holds every one of them, so the whole company is upgrades and no folder is created. **`shio-of-mgvime` is the one exception and is not touched**: its `greek` row is already `venerated`, on 4 Φεβρουαρίου, so a reader may not move it; that he is listed here too is a second Greek day and is left in the report. **The Greek adds the whole story of the mission and no years at all**: the flight deeper into the desert when the crowds broke his stillness, the Theotokos appearing in a dream and commanding him to choose twelve and go to Iberia, the names written on separate papers and laid on the holy table, the night of prayer, the twelve papers an angel took from the altar into his hands before them all, the monk Euthymius left as abbot of the skete, the angel warning Bishop Eulogius of the Georgian capital of their coming, the bishop going out with clergy and people to meet them, the wonder like Pentecost by which John spoke Georgian, and their preaching through all Georgia and their veneration of the blessed places Saint Nina had passed, whom the page sends to 14 Ιανουαρίου. **No year, no hymn**, and the page does not say where any of the twelve settled afterwards — the sees and monasteries in their corpus names come from the Romanian side and nothing here is added to them. **The Greek form is Ισέ, not Ιεσσαί**, and it is stored as the page prints it; the corpus's English form Jesse comes from the Romanian side and is not changed. The page does not name Tsilkani.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 20.05.2026 (7. мај ст. ст.) — „Преподобни оци грузијски.“

attestations.note: **The heading names nobody and the body enumerates the whole company, so the citation above is the heading whole** — „Преподобни оци грузијски.“ — per BRIEF-SERBIAN.md §4's synaxis ruling and the coordinator's first ruling for an enumerated company, and the Serbian name form is read out of the body's naming clause: „А имена су њихова: Авид, Антоније, Давид, Зинон, Тадеј, Иса, Издериос, Јосиф, Михаил, Пир, Стефан и Шијо.“ — twelve bare forenames, no rank word on any of them and no epithet, with Началник свих ових ... био је свети Јован Зедазнијски standing before the list for their leader. **The identification is the set and not the name**: the corpus already keeps these thirteen men together on this very menologion day, out of doxologia's «Sfântul Cuvios Ioan Zedazneli, dimpreună cu 12 ucenici din Georgia» and saint.gr's «Όσιος Ιωάννης και οι μαθητές αυτού», and the Prologue's twelve names map one-to-one onto the twelve folders, eleven of them unmistakably — Антоније, Давид, Зинон, Тадеј, Јосиф, Михаил, Пир, Стефан, Шијо, Иса for Ise of Tsilkani and Издериос for Isidore of Samtavisi — which forces the twelfth, Авид for Abibus of Nekresi, because it is the only slot and the only name left. **`types` was deliberately not touched on any of the thirteen.** Преподобни in that heading heads a company of thirteen whose own folders carry ranks three other calendars gave them — `hieromartyr` and `bishop` for Abibus, `hierarch` and `bishop` for Jesse, `stylite` for Anthony — and a rank word covering a whole company is not evidence about one man's own grade; adding it could make `honorific.js` compose a different word to every reader, which is the `boris-michael-of-bulgaria` ruling. **No `locations` were taken**: Georgia is a country. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion. **A FIRST DATE**: this folder held no `dates` at all, and the entry's „У VI веку“ gives it a `floruit` of 501–600, the same interval `anthony-of-martkopi` already holds from doxologia's identical statement.

floruit.note: Охридски пролог за 7. мај ст. ст.: „У VI веку, а на двесто година после тога како је света Нина проповедала Јеванђеље у Грузији, јави се Пресвета Богоматер Јовану, подвижнику Антиохијском, и нареди му да избере дванаест својих ученика и оде у Грузију“ — the century the book gives for the mission itself. The same interval stands on `anthony-of-martkopi` from doxologia’s identical statement. days.pravoslavie.ru’s life agrees and narrows the end: «Это произошло в конце VI века.» Carried forward unchanged, with the death below added beside it (7 October 2026).

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru’s life for 2 декабря ст. ст. closes his repose «Это произошло в конце VI века.» — the first statement of his death any source has given this folder, which held a floruit only. The bounds are the last third of that century; the page gives no year and no age, and the one calendar date it does fix is the day, 18 августа, and not the year.
